Name: Valley of Aven
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include the Baalbek area, Wadi Qelt, and Beth-eden
Description: The Valley of Aven, the 'valley of wickedness', was named in Amos's oracle against Damascus, whose people would go into captivity and whose king's house would fall.
BiblicalSignificance: The valley is an oracle name: a place of idolatry in Amos's judgment on Syria, not a valley elsewhere described in the narrative.
